Shared_Core_Chemistry: Primary source states same phosphorothioate backbone composition; both are 5-10-5 2′MOE/5mC gapmer constructs
Construct_and_Regimen_Differences: Olezarsen adds GalNAc3 targeting and uses 50/80 mg every 4 weeks versus unconjugated volanesorsen 300 mg weekly; studies and populations are not head-to-head
Parent_Platelet_Evidence: APPROACH: 16/33 <100,000/µL and 2/33 <25,000/µL; multiple platelet-related dose changes/discontinuations
Derivative_Platelet_Evidence: BALANCE/FDA: strict severe platelet AESI 0/43; decreased platelet count 5/43 vs 1/23; no treated patient <50,000/µL
Scientific_Inference: The nucleotide sequence cannot carry one universal clinical thrombocytopenia label. Construct, delivery, dose intensity, interval, exposure, disease context, and monitoring must remain explicit.
Permitted_Model_Use: Treatment-aware risk modeling; context feature ablation; narrative evidence that sequence-only prediction is incomplete
Prohibited_Claim: Do not claim GalNAc alone caused the lower risk, and do not label the shared sequence intrinsically safe or toxic.

Shared_Core_Chemistry: Same nucleotide sequence and closely related full-PS 5-10-5 2′MOE ASO moiety; eplontersen is GalNAc3-conjugated
Construct_and_Regimen_Differences: Eplontersen 45 mg every 4 weeks versus inotersen 300 mg weekly; JAMA comparison uses historical placebo, while the switch analysis is within-participant but non-randomized
Parent_Platelet_Evidence: NEURO-TTR: 60/112 confirmed <140,000/µL; 3/112 severe <25,000/µL with platelet-reactive IgG; one fatal intracranial hemorrhage
Derivative_Platelet_Evidence: NEURO-TTRansform: thrombocytopenia 3/144 vs 1/60 historical placebo, mild/resolved; switch cohort mean nadir -40.7% on inotersen versus -3.2% after eplontersen
Comparison_Design: Cross-trial plus within-participant matched-sequence natural experiment
Scientific_Inference: The same nucleotide sequence can show substantially different platelet-risk profiles under different targeting, dose, interval, and exposure contexts.
Permitted_Model_Use: Treatment-aware risk modeling; within-sequence context analysis; validation of context-feature necessity
Prohibited_Claim: Do not treat historical placebo as concurrent randomization, and do not attribute the difference uniquely to GalNAc.
Evidence_Confidence: HIGH sequence/clinical evidence; MODERATE-HIGH natural-experiment inference
